units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 55:8">Gen. R. s. 55</cite>, end <he>חבשה שח׳ וכ׳</he> the harnessing which Abraham did.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 9:12:4">Y. Sot. IX, 24ᵇ</cite> top; <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 15:7">Tosef. ib. XV, 7</cite> (Var. lect.) <he>חֲבָשׁוֹ</he> attempted to force him by imprisonment, v. <cite ref="H00040"><he>חָבַט</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 2:5">Deut. R. s. 2</cite> <he>היה חוֹבֵשׁ וכ׳</he> he could imprison (condemn) whom he wanted to, opp. <cite ref="Q00110"><he>פָּדָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 8:6:2">Y. Pes. VIII, 36ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>חֲבָשׁוּהוּ ישראל</he> if Israelites keep him in prison (and promised to let him free for Passover); a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="H00037"><he>חָבוּשׁ</he></cite>, <he>חֲבוּשָׁה</he>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 5b">Ber. 5ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>אין ח׳ מתיר וכ׳</he> a prisoner cannot release himself from prison (one cannot do as much for himself as he can for others).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 20a:11">B. Bath. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>חֲבוּשֵׁי מלכית</he> imprisoned by royal authority; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (agric.) to narrow in, to plant one species too near another species, to produce Kilayim (כִּלְאַיִם).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 3:1:6">Y. Kil. III, beg., 28ᶜ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 9:2:3">Y. Sabb. IX, 11ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>אין מין פוגע בחברו לחוֹבְשׁוֹ</he> one species must not meet with the other (in the soil) so as to prevent its growth.

Y. Kil. III, 28ᵈ אורכו בכמה חוֹבֵשׁ at what distance, lengthwise, does one interfere with the other (so as to be forbidden to plant)? Ib. II, 28ᵃ אין אדם חובש וכ׳ one cannot make forbidden as Kilayim that which is not his own (by planting too near); a. fr.—Part. pass. חָבוּשׁ, f. חֲבוּשָׁה too closely planted between different species. Ib. I, end, 27ᶜ שעורה ח׳ באמצע barley planted between.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 2:9">Keth. II, 9</cite> <he>האשה שנֶחְבְשָׁה וכ׳</he> a married woman that has been detained in the power of gentiles, if for money &c.; a. e.

senses.gloss: to be planted too closely, to become forbidden as Kilayim. Y. Kil. III, 28ᵈ bot. נ׳ בשמונה becomes forbidden by a neighborhood of eight cubits.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>שלא יֵחָבֵשׁ אלא וכ׳</he> that it is not made forbidden at a distance of more than eight cubits.

senses.gloss: to be the cause of prohibition as Kilayim. Ib. שלא יַחֲבִישׁ וכ׳ that it does not cause a prohibition at a distance of more &c.

units: <cite ref="Shabbat 152b:5">Sabb. 152ᵇ</cite> <he>והן יִתְחַבְּשׁוּ וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>יֵחָבְשׁוּ</he>) and they, themselves, shall be kept in prison.
